title: headcount-sync-hiring-prep-scratchpad
content:
Notes for weekly headcount sync w/ Priya + Maya (quick personal scratchpad)

Goal: align hiring priorities for H1 FY26, validate interview loop bandwidth, finalize asks for upcoming council. Quick decisions we need: which 3 roles to prioritize for Dedicated infra, any level bumps, and which backfills can wait until Q3.

Agenda (15-20m):
- Quick pipeline status (counts / stage)
- Prioritization matrix (impact x time to onboard)
- Interview loop capacity & blockers
- Budget/level ask to submit to finance (deadline Fri)
- Action items and owners

Pipeline snapshot (as of 2026-02-18):
- Serving infra eng (L4-L5): 5 active candidates (2 take-home, 1 on-site scheduled 2/25)
- Runtime perf SWE (L5): 3 active (1 offer in process, 1 pending ref check)
- Platform infra (L3): 2 internal transfers interested
- SRE (L4): 4 candidates (slow loop, interviewers overloaded)
- PM (inference product): 1 strong candidate pending exec sync

Initial prioritization notes:
- Top priority: Serving infra eng L5 (Direct impact on Dedicated throughput; blockers for Dedicated launch). Strong case for 1 immediate hire + prefer to keep 1 buffer.
- 2nd priority: Runtime perf L5 (we have one verbal offer; if accepted this unlocks perf wins).
- Lower priority: Platform infra L3 backfills - can delay to Q3 if budget constrained.

Interview loop issues:
- Interviewer fatigue: Eng leads (Maya, Eric) overloaded with product rollouts. Need to reassign some loop stages or use take-homes more.
- Senior loop timing: scheduling delays (avg 12 days between stages) - candidate drop risk.
- Missing rubric for SRE hands-on exercise - (TODO: Priya to draft).

Questions for the sync:
- Can we reallocate two rotations of interviewers from product teams for next 3 weeks? (ask Maya)
- Are we comfortable pushing Platform infra L3 to Q3 if finance pushback? (ask Priya/Finance)
- Do we want to approve level-bump for one L4->L5 (serving) to make offer competitive? Budget delta ~ +15k OTE.

Draft ask for hiring council (short blurb):
- "Requesting approval for 2 hires in Eng - Serving (1 L5, 1 L4) to support Dedicated launch and reduce technical debt. Anticipated ramp timeline 3-4 months. Requesting authorization to use reserve headcount earmarked for infra hires in Q1."

Risks & notes:
- If runtime perf offer falls through, our backlog on quantization/kernel work slips by ~6 weeks. Plan B: move one contractor from release-engineering for short term (costly).
- Interview no-shows are up - consider 2x calendar reminders and 1 short note from hiring manager day before.

Action items (assignments + due):
- Priya: draft SRE exercise rubric + upload to hiring folder (due 2026-02-24)
- Maya: confirm interviewer rotations + blocked OOO calendar slots (due 2026-02-22)
- Eric: prep hiring council blurb w/ cost delta and ramp plan (due 2026-02-23)
- Ryan (me): finalize prioritization slide & send to Priya for finance by Fri (due 2026-02-20) - ALSO: schedule follow-up 1:1 with Maya re: interviewer swaps
- Hiring ops: confirm candidate travel logistics for on-site 2/25 (owned by recruiting)

Notes to self / talking points for 1:1 w/ Priya:
- Emphasize Dedicated launch timelines & risk if we delay serving hires
- Ask about potential to reallocate one contracted headcount from infra to runtime perf for 8 weeks
- Clarify hiring freeze thresholds if any (rumor of mid-Q2 cost review)

Loose TODOs (scratch):
- Check comp bands for L5 in Bay area vs remote comps (HR comp doc)
- Pull attrition numbers for eng-serving-runtime last 12 months (for council)
- Prepare quick slide: "impact if hires delayed" (metrics: time to repair, throughput regression, backlog size)

Quick timeline:
- Tue (2/20): send prioritized list to finance
- Wed (2/21): headcount sync meeting w/ Priya+Maya (prep this doc)
- Thu (2/22): finalize council blurb + submit

Random notes:
- Candidate J. Patel (serving L5) has strong benchmark kernel work - talk to Samir for intro before offer.
- Consider pushing for expedited offer for runtime perf candidate (use signing bonus)

End scratch - will clean after sync.
